s0901.literal: Ying Gong taught Meng Qing of Donghai; Meng Qing taught Suimeng of Lu; Suimeng taught Yan Pengzu of Donghai and Yan Anle of Lu.
s0901.idiomatic: Ying Gong taught Meng Qing of Donghai; Meng Qing taught Suimeng of Lu; Suimeng taught Yan Pengzu of Donghai and Yan Anle of Lu.

s0902.literal: 故後漢公羊有嚴氏、顏氏之學，與谷梁三家並立。.
s0902.idiomatic: 故後漢公羊有嚴氏、顏氏之學，與谷梁三家並立。.

s0903.literal: 漢末，何休又作公羊解說。.
s0903.idiomatic: 漢末，何休又作公羊解說。.

s0904.literal: 而左氏漢初出於張蒼之家，本無傳者。.
s0904.idiomatic: 而左氏漢初出於張蒼之家，本無傳者。.

s0905.literal: By the time of Emperor Wen, Grand Tutor Jia Yi of Liang composed exegesis and taught Gong of Zhao.
s0905.idiomatic: By the time of Emperor Wen, Grand Tutor Jia Yi of Liang composed exegesis and taught Gong of Zhao.

s0906.literal: Afterward Liu Xin supervised collation of classics and records, examined and corrected them, and wished to establish them in the schools, but the Confucian scholars did not respond.
s0906.idiomatic: Afterward Liu Xin supervised collation of classics and records, examined and corrected them, and wished to establish them in the schools, but the Confucian scholars did not respond.

s0907.literal: By the Jianwu era, Director of the Masters of Writing Han Xin requested establishment but it was not carried out.
s0907.idiomatic: By the Jianwu era, Director of the Masters of Writing Han Xin requested establishment but it was not carried out.

s0908.literal: 時陳元最明左傳，又上Documents訟之。.
s0908.idiomatic: 時陳元最明左傳，又上Documents訟之。.

s0909.literal: 於是乃以魏郡李封為左氏博士。.
s0909.idiomatic: 於是乃以魏郡李封為左氏博士。.

s0910.literal: Afterward obstinate Confucian scholars repeatedly debated it at court.
s0910.idiomatic: Afterward obstinate Confucian scholars repeatedly debated it at court.

s0911.literal: When Feng died, it was then abolished.
s0911.idiomatic: When Feng died, it was then abolished.

s0913.literal: 永平中，能為左氏者，擢高第為講郎。.
s0913.idiomatic: 永平中，能為左氏者，擢高第為講郎。.

s0914.literal: Afterward Jia Kui and Fu Qian both composed exegesis.
s0914.idiomatic: Afterward Jia Kui and Fu Qian both composed exegesis.

s0915.literal: By Wei it circulated in the world.
s0915.idiomatic: By Wei it circulated in the world.

s0916.literal: 晉時，杜預又為經傳集解。.
s0916.idiomatic: 晉時，杜預又為經傳集解。.

s0917.literal: 谷梁範甯注、公羊何休注、左氏服虔、杜預注，俱立國學。.
s0917.idiomatic: 谷梁範甯注、公羊何休注、左氏服虔、杜預注，俱立國學。.

s0918.literal: 然公羊、谷梁，但試讀文，而不能通其義。.
s0918.idiomatic: 然公羊、谷梁，但試讀文，而不能通其義。.

s0919.literal: 後學三傳通講，而左氏唯傳服義。.
s0919.idiomatic: 後學三傳通講，而左氏唯傳服義。.

s0920.literal: 至隋，杜氏盛行，服義及公羊、谷梁浸微，今殆無師說。.
s0920.idiomatic: 至隋，杜氏盛行，服義及公羊、谷梁浸微，今殆無師說。.

s0921.literal: 孝經古文孝經一卷孔安國傳。.
s0921.idiomatic: 孝經古文孝經一卷孔安國傳。.

s0922.literal: At the end of Liang it was lost; now it is suspected not to be the old text.
s0922.idiomatic: At the end of Liang it was lost; now it is suspected not to be the old text.

s0955.literal: Above: 十八部，合六十三卷.
s0955.idiomatic: Above: 十八部，合六十三卷.

s0956.literal: Counting lost books together, 五十九部 titles, 一百一十四卷 scrolls.
s0956.idiomatic: Including lost books, totaling 五十九部 titles and 一百一十四卷 scrolls.

s0957.literal: Filial piety is Heaven's norm, Earth's righteousness, and human conduct.
s0957.idiomatic: Filial piety is Heaven's norm, Earth's righteousness, and human conduct.

s0958.literal: From the Son of Heaven down to the common people, though honor and humility differ, in the practice of filial piety the meaning is one.
s0958.idiomatic: From the Son of Heaven down to the common people, though honor and humility differ, in the practice of filial piety the meaning is one.

s0959.literal: The earlier kings relied on it to govern the state, transform All-under-Heaven, and thus could achieve order without severity and completion without austerity.
s0959.idiomatic: The earlier kings relied on it to govern the state, transform All-under-Heaven, and thus could achieve order without severity and completion without austerity.

s0960.literal: This is truly the utmost virtue of living beings and the essential Way of kings.
s0960.idiomatic: This is truly the utmost virtue of living beings and the essential Way of kings.

s0961.literal: 孔子既敘六經，題目不同，指意差別，恐斯道離散，故作孝經，以總會之，明其枝流雖分，本萌於孝者也。.
s0961.idiomatic: 孔子既敘六經，題目不同，指意差別，恐斯道離散，故作孝經，以總會之，明其枝流雖分，本萌於孝者也。.

s0962.literal: When Qin burned books, it was hidden by Yan Zhi of Hejian.
s0962.idiomatic: When Qin burned books, it was hidden by Yan Zhi of Hejian.

s0963.literal: At the beginning of Han, Zhi's son Zhen brought it forth—in all eighteen chapters—and the Chief of the Changsun clan, Erudite Jiang Weng, Director of the Palace Workshop Hou Cang, Remonstrance Grandee Ji Feng, and Marquis Zhang Yu of Anchang all named their schools after it.
s0963.idiomatic: At the beginning of Han, Zhi's son Zhen brought it forth—in all eighteen chapters—and the Chief of the Changsun clan, Erudite Jiang Weng, Director of the Palace Workshop Hou Cang, Remonstrance Grandee Ji Feng, and Marquis Zhang Yu of Anchang all named their schools after it.

s0964.literal: There was also 古文Classic of Filial Piety, transmitted by 與《古文尚書》同出，而長孫有《閨門》一章，其餘經文，大較相似，篇簡缺解，又有衍出三章，並前合為二十二章，孔安國為之.
s0964.idiomatic: There was also 古文Classic of Filial Piety, transmitted by 與《古文尚書》同出，而長孫有《閨門》一章，其餘經文，大較相似，篇簡缺解，又有衍出三章，並前合為二十二章，孔安國為之.

s0965.literal: When Liu Xiang supervised collation of classics and records, he compared Yan's text against the ancient script, removed what was redundant and confusing, and fixed it at eighteen chapters.
s0965.idiomatic: When Liu Xiang supervised collation of classics and records, he compared Yan's text against the ancient script, removed what was redundant and confusing, and fixed it at eighteen chapters.

s0966.literal: Zheng Zhong and Ma Rong both annotated it.
s0966.idiomatic: Zheng Zhong and Ma Rong both annotated it.

s0967.literal: There is also a Zheng commentary, transmitted as being by Zheng Xuan; its established meaning differs from Xuan's annotations on his other books, hence it is doubted.
s0967.idiomatic: There is also a Zheng commentary, transmitted as being by Zheng Xuan; its established meaning differs from Xuan's annotations on his other books, hence it is doubted.

s0968.literal: In the Liang dynasty the Anguo and Zheng schools were both listed in the National University, but Anguo's text was lost in the turmoil of Liang.
s0968.idiomatic: In the Liang dynasty the Anguo and Zheng schools were both listed in the National University, but Anguo's text was lost in the turmoil of Liang.

s0969.literal: In Chen and under Zhou and Qi, only the Zheng school was transmitted.
s0969.idiomatic: In Chen and under Zhou and Qi, only the Zheng school was transmitted.

s0970.literal: 至隋，秘Documents監王劭于京師訪得孔傳，送至河間劉炫。.
s0970.idiomatic: 至隋，秘Documents監王劭于京師訪得孔傳，送至河間劉炫。.

s0971.literal: Xuan ordered its gains and losses, set forth its discussions and subcommentary, and lectured among the people; it gradually reached the court, and afterward an edict was issued establishing it alongside the Zheng school.
s0971.idiomatic: Xuan ordered its gains and losses, set forth its discussions and subcommentary, and lectured among the people; it gradually reached the court, and afterward an edict was issued establishing it alongside the Zheng school.

s0972.literal: Confucian scholars clamored, all saying Xuan had composed it himself and that it was not Confucius's old text; moreover the secret repository had never had the book.
s0972.idiomatic: Confucian scholars clamored, all saying Xuan had composed it himself and that it was not Confucius's old text; moreover the secret repository had never had the book.

s0973.literal: 又雲魏氏遷洛，未達華語，孝文帝命侯伏侯可悉陵，以夷言譯孝經之旨，教於國人，謂之國語孝經。.
